# blst upstream source

This package contains the C implementation and generated assembly from
[`supranational/blst`](https://github.com/supranational/blst), pinned at commit
`de54cd4684a3adba193a6c50ca5861c8c32c3b8a`.

The source is unmodified. `Package.swift` is local packaging for Swift Package Manager.
